units.rawText: You're so bold, Professor. Daring to touch me. Do you even know what happens to the humans who touch me? They all die instantly.
units.displayText: You're so bold, Professor. Daring to touch me. Do you even know what happens to the humans who touch me? They all die instantly.

units.rawText: I wonder if it's something in the Cloud that gives you the courage—or maybe you're blessed with a brilliant constitution, immune to all poisons.

units.rawText: Ah, Professor, you're falling... I'll inject you with the antidote right away.
